segments.zh: 想一想。

segments.en: Okay, so think it through.
segments.zh: 好吧，好好想想。

segments.en: So here, the boss said that he took the time to think through my suggestions.
segments.zh: 所以在这里，老板说他花时间思考我的建议。

segments.en: So think through, what does that mean?
segments.zh: 所以想一想，这是什么意思？

segments.en: To think carefully about all of the details of something.
segments.zh: 仔细思考某事的所有细节。

segments.en: Okay, so to take into consideration all the aspects.
segments.zh: 好的，所以要考虑所有方面。

segments.en: Right, so why don't we give an example?
segments.zh: 对了，我们为什么不举个例子呢？

segments.en: If you're thinking through a plan, right?
segments.zh: 如果你在想一个计划，对吧？

segments.en: You don't just think about the end, the outcome.
segments.zh: 你不只是想结束，结果。

segments.en: You want to think about all of the small details, the steps in that plan.
segments.zh: 您想考虑所有小细节，该计划中的步骤。

segments.en: Okay, so maybe I want to buy a new car, but it's a lot of money.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许我想买一辆新车，但这是一大笔钱。

segments.en: So I really have to think it through.
segments.zh: 所以我真的必须考虑一下。

segments.en: So you have to think carefully about everything that is involved in buying the new car.
segments.zh: 所以你必须仔细考虑购买新车所涉及的一切。

segments.en: All the money you're going to have to, you know, not spend on parties.
segments.zh: 你知道，你将不得不花的所有钱，而不是花在聚会上。

segments.en: Exactly, you have to think it through.
segments.zh: 确实，你必须仔细考虑。

segments.en: You have to analyze it very carefully.
segments.zh: 你必须非常仔细地分析它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let's give a few examples of how we can use this phrase.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们举几个例子来说明我们如何使用这个短语。

segments.en: Hey, Marco, have you thought through my suggestions?
segments.zh: 嘿，马可，你想过我的建议吗？

segments.en: I can say, you guys are very young.
segments.zh: 我可以说，你们都很年轻。

segments.en: I think you should think it through before you get married.
segments.zh: 我想你应该在结婚之前考虑清楚。

segments.en: Good advice.
segments.zh: 好建议。

segments.en: Okay, so to think it through.
segments.zh: 好吧，好好想想吧。

segments.en: Okay, so three great phrases and why don't we hear them one more time in our dialogue.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以三个很棒的短语，为什么我们在对话中再一次听到它们。

segments.en: And so that concludes my outline for our marketing strategy next year.
segments.zh: 这就是我明年营销策略的大纲。

segments.en: Thank you very much for your time.
segments.zh: 非常感谢您的宝贵时间。

segments.en: Hey, that was quite the presentation.
segments.zh: 刚才的演讲太精彩了。

segments.en: Honestly, I was completely blown away by your strategy outline.
segments.zh: 说真的，你的策略提纲让我眼前一亮。

segments.en: I've got to say, Alex, you really wowed me today.
segments.zh: 亚历克斯，你今天真让我刮目相看。

segments.en: Come on, it was nothing.
segments.zh: 哪里，没什么。

segments.en: I'm just doing my job.
segments.zh: 我只是在做我的工作。

segments.en: No, I think you deserve some recognition here.
segments.zh: 不，我觉得你值得表扬。

segments.en: I mean, if I look back on your previous presentations, this is a huge improvement.
segments.zh: 跟你之前的演讲相比，这次进步太大了。

segments.en: Well, Christian did give me a hand with the slides.
segments.zh: 克里斯蒂安帮我做了幻灯片。

segments.en: She's a real whiz on PowerPoint.
segments.zh: 她做PPT可真是一把好手。

segments.en: And I saw that you took on board my feedback about pricing strategies.
segments.zh: 我注意到你采纳了我对定价策略的建议。

segments.en: I really appreciate you taking the time to think through my suggestions.
segments.zh: 谢谢你认真考虑我的建议。

segments.en: Yeah, well, that was some good advice.
segments.zh: 是的，嗯，这是一个很好的建议。

segments.en: You made some really good points.
segments.zh: 你提出了一些非常好的观点。

segments.en: Well, I just wanted to say, well done.
segments.zh: 我就是想夸你一句：干得好。

segments.en: Really, you did a great job.
segments.zh: 真的，你做得很好。

segments.en: Okay, great dialogue and some interesting phrases for giving praise, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，很棒的对话和一些有趣的赞美短语，对吧？

segments.en: That's, I think, very important in the workplace.
segments.zh: 我认为，这在工作场所非常重要。

segments.en: Yeah, and you know what, I read recently that something like six out of every ten employees don't get regular praise from their boss.
segments.zh: 是的，你知道吗，我最近读到，每十个员工中有六个没有得到老板的定期表扬。

segments.en: It's very important.
segments.zh: 这很重要。

segments.en: And in some cultures, well, it's not very common to praise or to give positive feedback to their employees.
segments.zh: 在某些文化中，赞美或向员工提供积极的反馈并不常见。

segments.en: Yeah, but I think for Western employees, actually, it's really important and it helps them work harder the more times they hear, job well done.
segments.zh: 是的，但我认为对于西方员工来说，这真的很重要，它可以帮助他们越听越多，工作做得越好。

segments.en: Yeah, very good.
segments.zh: 对，很好。

segments.en: So now you have the tools that maybe you can use with your employees or...
segments.zh: 所以现在你有了可以与员工一起使用的工具，或者...

segments.en: With your friends.
segments.zh: 和你的朋友。

segments.en: With your friends.
segments.zh: 和你的朋友。

segments.en: Yep.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay, so if you have any questions, comments, or doubts, please come to our website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 好的，如果您有任何问题、意见或疑问，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: Yep, Marco and I are always around to help you out.
segments.zh: 是的，马可和我总是在身边帮助你。

segments.en: So until next time, thanks for listening and goodbye.
segments.zh: 所以直到下一次，感谢您的聆听和再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
